feeding_claim.verbatim: We do not feed any corn or soy to any of our livestock, including the poultry!

notes: Visits by appointment. Site products page has no beef category although its title mentions grass-fed beef cuts, so beef is not listed. Homepage Instagram embed mentions The Downtown Pantry in Crestview and The Market of Pace; not confirmed as current outlets. FAQ says supplemental feed is non-GMO, with hay. Site says raw milk from its a2a2 Jersey herd; Florida allows raw milk sales only as pet food per the raw milk guide. Barn2Door store blocked fetching, so store contents unread.
